in_sanskrit.name: देवेशान्श
in_sanskrit.meaning: God's Abode or God's Abode of Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: देव (Deva) + ईशान (Ishana) + श (Sha) + न् (N) + श (Sha) = देवेशान्श. Meaning: God's Abode or God's Abode of Shiva

in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (Deva) + ईशान (Ishana) + श (Sha) + न् (N) + श (Sha) = देवेशान्श Meaning: God's Abode or God's Abode of Shiva

in_tamil.name: தேவேஶான்ஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: தேவ (Thevam) + ஏஶ (Eesam) + ஶ (Sham) + ன் (N) + ஶ (Sham) = தேவேஶான்ஷ Meaning: God's Abode or God's Abode of Shiva

in_telugu.name: దేవేశాణ్ష

in_marathi.name: Deveshansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Graceful Gift
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deveshansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deveshansh is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Deva' (God) and 'Shansh' (Gift). This name symbolizes the graceful gift bestowed by the gods upon a child.
